Attached: draft_TIA_response_ClearHealth_20261007.pdf (contains our proposed mapping and standard addendum clause language).

2) Evidence & subprocessors: Attached redwood_subprocessors_v3.csv lists current subprocessors, their country of processing, and whether they store logs. We will provide an export map showing where different workloads can be routed. See SOC2 snapshot for controls baseline.

3) Routing policy: We support per-account routing policies that can enforce region constraints (EU-only) for both Hosted and Dedicated. There are two caveats: 1) third-party cache/CDN logs may have routing traces — we provide configuration to minimize these and 2) per-token latency tradeoffs when routing to specific regions.

- Procurement: confirm acceptance of UK addendum and share any prefatory redlines (DocuSign link referenced).
- Legal/Security: review draft_TIA_response and mark controls needing evidence (we can prioritize KMS proof, export mapping, and subprocessor attestations).

- Evidence handoff: we will stage artifacts in a shared Drive folder (link below) and provide a two-week window for sampling and Q&A.

Elena / team — quick technical clarifications from infra/security side:

- KMS: For Hosted customers that need key isolation we offer tenant-dedicated keys backed by HSM and a contractual commitment on key rotation windows. For Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) customers can supply their own KMS credentials; our deployment supports AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, and on-prem PKCS#11 HSMs.

- Subprocessor geography: The CSV lists a small set of analytics vendors that operate in the US and APAC. For EU-only enforcement we can exclude those vendors from processing EU-marked workloads — but that requires enabling our per-route "geo-fence" toggle and a short integration test.

- Logs & retention: Per our standard policy we retain inference logs (non-content telemetry) for 30 days; for enterprise customers we can extend retention windows or configure shorter rolling windows.

I'll prepare a short playbook for the technical kickoff that includes test vectors for routing enforcement. Proposed times: Tue 2026-10-13 09:00-10:00 PT or Wed 10/14 14:00-15:00 PT.
